question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing center midfielder, and Claire is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Bob and Alice trade positions. Finally, Claire and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) center midfielder
(C) right winger
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: right midfielder, center midfielder, right winger
1. Claire swaps with Bob: right midfielder, right winger, center midfielder
2. Bob swaps with Alice: right winger, right midfielder, center midfielder
3. Claire swaps with Bob: right winger, center midfielder, right midfielder
Alice is playing right winger, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
